description: Defines the DVB Service Description Table (SDT) class and its nested ServiceIterator class, including methods for parsing and iterating over DVB SDT data.

classes.name: SDT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Service Description Table, providing access to transport stream ID, network ID, and service iteration.

classes.name: ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing services within an SDT, providing methods to access service properties and descriptors.

methods.name: SDT::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the SDT object contains valid data.

methods.name: SDT::TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the SDT.

methods.name: SDT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID from the SDT data.

methods.name: SDT::Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the services listed in the SDT.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current service iterator position is valid.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next service.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::EIT_PF
methods.description: Returns whether the service has EIT present in the present/following table.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::EIT_Schedule
methods.description: Returns whether the service has EIT schedule information.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::IsFreeToAir
methods.description: Indicates if the service is free-to-air.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::RunningMode
methods.description: Returns the running status of the service.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors associated with the service.
